title: PoCoAttn: Position-Content Collaborative Sparse Attention for Fast and High-Fidelity Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.20307v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video diffusion transformers rely on 3D full attention over tens of thousands of spatiotemporal tokens, and its quadratic cost dominates inference latency. Sparse attention reduces this cost, but existing methods face a dilemma: static methods apply predefined masks and cannot capture input-dependent attention, whereas dynamic methods reconstruct the sparse mask repeatedly, paying online to rediscover positional structure that is largely stable across inputs. To this end, we propose PoCoAttn, a training-free sparse attention framework that separates input-stable from input-dependent attention and resolves the former offline and the latter online. PoCoAttn features: (1) A relative-offset analysis of 3D query-key pairs, which shows that video attention decomposes into an input-stable positional prior that carries most of the attention mass and a small content-dependent residual. (2) A position-content collaborative sparse attention mecha

translated_title: PoCoAttn：面向快速高保真视频生成的位置-内容协同稀疏注意力
translated_abstract: 视频扩散Transformer依赖于对数万个时空token进行3D全注意力计算，其二次方开销主导了推理延迟。稀疏注意力可以降低这一成本，但现有方法面临两难困境：静态方法采用预定义掩码，无法捕捉依赖于输入的注意力；而动态方法需要反复在线重建稀疏掩码，为重新发现那些在不同输入之间基本稳定的位置结构付出了额外代价。为此，我们提出了PoCoAttn，这是一个无需训练的稀疏注意力框架，它将输入稳定型注意力与输入依赖型注意力分离开来，并分别通过离线和在线方式加以处理。PoCoAttn的特点包括：(1) 对3D查询-键对进行相对偏移分析，表明视频注意力可以分解为承载了大部分注意力权重的输入稳定位置先验，以及一个较小的内容依赖残差；(2) 一种位置-内容协同的稀疏注意力机制……（摘要原文在此处截断，后续内容缺失）
tldr: 提出无需训练的稀疏注意力框架PoCoAttn，将视频注意力分解为离线处理的输入稳定位置先验与在线处理的内容依赖残差，从而在大幅降低计算开销的同时实现快速且高保真的视频生成。
